summary: Adecoagro S.A. filed a Form 6-K on April 24, 2026, announcing a cash dividend declared by its Board of Directors on April 23, 2026. The dividend is $0.12126801 per share, totaling $17.5 million, with a record date of May 4, 2026, and a payment date of May 19, 2026. This is the first of two equal tranches, with the second payable around November 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No transaction, restructuring, or activist activity is involved. The filing is purely a capital distribution announcement, warranting no further analysis.
